{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute number of loyal customers and converted loyal customers
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
converted_loyal = loyal_df['converted'].sum()

# Compute fraction converted
fraction_converted = converted_loyal / n_loyal

# Print all required numbers
print(f"n_loyal: {n_loyal}")
print(f"converted_loyal: {converted_loyal}")
print(f"fraction_converted: {fraction_converted}")"}
